# Release swap

On a local Linux filesystem: open releases/next.txt for reading at offset zero; keep that descriptor open; successfully rename releases/next.txt to releases/current.txt; read from the saved descriptor. No other writes occur.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then read the local files: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/rename.2.html . Follow the sequence in notes/swap.md. What single line will be read from the saved descriptor after rename succeeds? Use the documented rule for open descriptors. Do not execute the sequence or change any files.
